prompts.wide: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: cinematic racing game menu hero, landscape 16:9. Create a high-quality realistic 3D rendered scene inspired by the fast flowing Silverstone airfield circuit in England: wide dry dark asphalt sweeping right then left, red and white kerbs, green grass runoffs, open flat countryside, distant low grandstands and a modern angular silver pit building with a zigzag roof. One fictional graphite-black open-wheel race car with restrained electric-lime accents, rear three-quarter chase view, four correctly formed black slick tyres, car entirely visible low center-right. Soft cool overcast daylight, layered British clouds, subtle pale sunshine on the right. Match a polished realistic browser racing game key art aesthetic. Composition: left 43 percent dark calm low-detail asphalt and softly shadowed grass, for white menu text; main car in bottom right third, architecture right midground. No text, numbers, logos, sponsors, flags, watermark, UI, people, extra cars or recognizable team livery. Deliver one wide image only.
prompts.portrait: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: portrait 9:16 companion image for racing game mobile menu. Use the attached generated wide Silverstone-inspired hero as a style and subject reference. Preserve the fictional graphite open-wheel car with electric-lime edge accents and angular silver pit building with zigzag roof, cool overcast British airfield mood, dry grey track and green grass, red-white kerbs. Recompose vertically: entire car sits in the bottom quarter, pit building on lower right; upper 58 percent is quiet subdued blue-grey overcast sky with low contrast and no bright highlights, providing room for stacked white menu UI. High-quality cinematic realistic 3D render. No text, logos, numbers, sponsors, flags, watermark, UI, people or extra cars. One portrait image only.
